def _matches(project: Project, list_filter: str) -> bool:
    if list_filter in (FILTER_ALL, FILTER_MINE):
        return True
    return project.state == list_filter


def _is_closed(project: Project) -> bool:
    return project.state == ProjectStateEnum.COMPLETED


def _is_internal(project: Project) -> bool:
    return project.is_internal and not _is_closed(project)


def _is_planned(project: Project) -> bool:
    return not project.is_internal and project.state == ProjectStateEnum.PLANNED


def _is_regular(project: Project) -> bool:
    return not (_is_closed(project) or _is_internal(project) or _is_planned(project))

content.text:
A planned internal project like "Mein Test" now appears under "Geplant", not under "Interne Projekte". The project tests pass and lint is clean. I haven't checked it in the running app, and nothing is committed yet.

**The cause:** the list checked "is it internal?" before "is it planned?", so any internal project went to "Interne Projekte" whatever its status. I changed that check in [project_list_state.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/states/project_list_state.py). Planned now comes first, and "Interne Projekte" only holds internal projects that are neither planned nor finished.

**Side effect:** new projects start as "Geplant" by default. So a new internal project now shows under "Geplant" until its status is changed.

I updated the existing test in [test_project_list.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_project_list.py) to cover this.

The hint on the project form still says the project is listed under "Interne Projekte", which is no longer true while it is planned. I left that text as it is.
